blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City Regional Trial Court (RTC) has again postponed the arraignment of Vice President Sara Duterte on three counts of grave threats on Friday, Oct. 9, partly due to a pending petition before the Supreme Court (SC). Duterte’s lawyer, Paul Laurence Lim, said RTC Branch 98, presided over by Judge Maria Angelica de Ramos, considered the defense’s petition for certiorari before the high court and its pending motion for partial reconsideration ad cautelam before canceling the scheduled arraignment. “Today was supposed to be the arraignment but we have pending motions,” Lim said in an interview. “Also because […]...
